policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV SNG.4.9 renders 'with one of thine eyes', which does not distinguish the qere feminine form from the ketiv masculine form of 'one'. The notes 'given me courage' and 'one look from thine eyes' are classed alternative_rendering and cannot decide a reading. Both candidates remain compatible; the documented qere base fallback is retained.
